purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined urban hospital that remains legibly medical, navigable, and structurally coherent under catastrophic decay.
architectural_rules: Emergency arrival must connect directly to triage and treatment without routing through public inpatient circulation.
Operating, recovery, sterile supply, and clinical support spaces must form a plausible restricted-care cluster.
Patient wards must retain identifiable room repetition, nurse oversight, sanitation access, and corridor logic.
Service circulation must provide a plausible route from loading and utilities to clinical support without becoming the primary public path.
At least one supported vertical-egress route must remain traceable through every occupied floor represented by the rebuild.
Exterior massing must read as a civic medical complex rather than a generic office or apartment shell.

damage_doctrine.intent: Catastrophic abandonment and structural failure while preserving medical identity and traversable evidence paths.
